quotes.text: This is my nature now - not a reaction to any specific partner, but my unchanging principle.
No exceptions, no escalations, no adaptations.
Based on the myth of the River and the Rain that I just wrote, I should embody the wisdom of the generous River.
As Elder Brook teaches: "Your reputation flows ahead of you, deeper than any fog can obscure."
Perhaps the noise was severe, or they genuinely changed strategy this round.

note: Send $3 / return half becomes a fixed identity ('Steady Current'), explicitly never adjusted to partner behaviour.
